Snapshots of the cookidoo.de recipe editor (pl-customer-recipes 1.174.12, 2026-10-20), from
[tobilektri/mcp-cookidoo](https://github.com/tobilektri/mcp-cookidoo) (MIT, see NOTICE):

- `editor_tm6.html`, `editor_tm7.html`: the settings dialog of the editor page for a TM6 and
  a TM7 recipe (trimmed to the dialog; the recipe ID is a placeholder).
- `editor_modes.json`: steps built with the editor dialog and accepted by Cookidoo, used to
  check that this server sends the same annotation data.
